mapper.insert: INSERT INTO student_course_table (student_id, course_id, sc_selecttime) VALUES (#{studentId}, #{courseId}, #{scSelecttime})
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM student_course_table WHERE student_id = #{studentId} AND course_id = #{courseId}
mapper.select: SELECT AVG(sc_score) as avgScore, MAX(sc_score) as maxScore, MIN(sc_score) as minScore, COUNT(CASE WHEN sc_score >= 60 THEN 1 END) as passCount, COUNT(*) as totalCount FROM student_course_table WHERE course_id = #{courseId} AND sc_score IS NOT NULL

SELECT c.course_id as courseId, c.course_name as courseName, c.course_credit as courseCredit, u.user_real_name as teacherName,
sc.sc_score as score, sc.sc_selecttime as selectTime FROM student_course_table sc LEFT JOIN course_table c ON sc.course_id = c.course_id LEFT JOIN user_table u ON c.teacher_id = u.user_id WHERE sc.student_id = #{studentId} ORDER BY sc.sc_selecttime DESC
